decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures the color palette, cross-location brand consistency, national positioning, and expanded future-location scope entailed for this Requirement.
The visual-design change does not alter the hub's existing location-routing behavior, and its simple, easy-to-navigate layout was already required.
The domain assignment is a separate same-message decision and is unaffected by the visual-style and location-page scope changes.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures adding future locations without redesign and retaining only wording as location-specific customization.
A shared visual design across location pages does not change the existing requirement for separate booking, revenue, sales, calendar, and management operations.
The source visual-design decision does not change the location sites' Wix Bookings platform or booking functionality.
